metadex.name: StashKit
metadex.purpose: Describe the foundational architecture, responsibilities, and constraints of the StashKit framework.

ontology.description: Ontology defines what exists: entities, fields, relationships, and allowed structures. In StashKit, ontology is expressed through Dexes (e.g., LexiDex).
guarantees: Ontology may be inspected by humans and machines
Ontology is not mutated during resolution

ontogeny.description: Ontogeny describes how identity is discovered over time. In StashKit, this is performed by Resolvers operating over ResolverState using selectable strategies.
guarantees: Resolution may be interrupted or resumed

identity.description: Identity represents resolved entities and their persisted form. Identity is recorded via StashCards and MuDex overlays.
guarantees: Identity is only asserted after sufficiency criteria are met
Identity records do not perform inference

resolvers.description: Resolvers are ontogeny engines. They coordinate Skills, reason over state, and decide when resolution is sufficient.

strategy_model.description: Resolution behavior is governed by interchangeable strategies (e.g., linear, adaptive). Strategies are not resolver subclasses.
guarantees: Strategy affects skill selection and revisit logic

defaults.behavior: Resolvers may be constructed without explicit skill graphs; sensible defaults are provided

skills.description: Skills are stateless execution units defined by capability contracts. They may live in StashKit, BoosterPacks, or third-party packages.
distribution: Third parties may publish independent Skills

descriptor.notes: Resolvers reason over SkillDescriptors, not implementations

cost_semantics.external: may be exposed as qualitative tiers

defaults.easy_mode: Common Skills may be instantiated with sensible defaults

stash.description: The Stash records resolved identity. It does not perform inference or resolution.
constraints: Only resolvers decide when to stash
Stash contents are append-only by default

boosterpacks.description: BoosterPacks compose Dex overlays, Skills, Resolvers, and configuration without modifying StashKit core.
